children: India's top sugar-producing state of Maharashtra has allowed mills to start crushing cane from October 15, two weeks earlier than last year, amid expectations of lower cane supplies, the state government said in a statement on Wednesday.
About 99 million metric tons of sugar cane is expected to be available for crushing in the new season, down from 104.5 million tons crushed this year, according to the state agriculture department.
India last month allowed duty-free imports of 1 million metric tons of raw sugar as the government seeks to bring down record-high domestic prices in the world's biggest sugar-consuming country.
